name: Bench Sprint
setup: Mark out the distance with cones on a flat, dry surface; start from a two-point stance.
cues: Push the ground back behind you.
Lean into the run like you are falling forward, then catch yourself.
Quick, quiet contacts under you.

faults.fault: Standing straight up in the first steps
faults.fix: Stay low and push the ground back for the first five steps.

faults.fault: Reaching out with the foot
faults.fix: Strike the ground under you, not out in front.
